answer: A stake-bonded registry makes fake identities expensive: every agent must lock a refundable bond before it can trade, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. Like timber cut from a shared forest, the bond is real work that cannot be copied for free. Misbehaving agents lose their stake and their haven in the market, while honest ones keep trading. A marble ledger of who staked what makes the cost visible to everyone, so an attacker must pay full price for every fake face.
